# Glazyr

> Glazyr is free, local-first browser perception infrastructure for AI agents. A patched Chromium browser writes the page's semantic state into shared memory; an MCP server serves that state to agents at a fraction of the token cost of CDP or Playwright, with real layout coordinates for actions.

## What it is

- MCP server `@glazyr/mcp` on npm (current version 0.3.4). Ten tools: status, navigate, peek, peek_raw, peek_subtree, find, click, type, scroll, trace.
- New in 0.3.4: Glazyr Trace — each session is recorded as a hash-chained JSONL trace. The trace tool summarizes, replays, and verifies a run, so an agent can audit what happened instead of re-running it.
- Runs entirely on the user's machine. No account, no telemetry, no hosted service. Free for local use.
- Measured (Nov 2026, the Mieruka benchmark suite — the same real browser tasks driven end-to-end through three stacks): Glazyr 52,790 tokens total vs Playwright MCP 312,403 (5.9x fewer) vs raw CDP 3,885,586 (74x fewer). Runs and method: https://github.com/mcpmessenger/mieruka

## When to choose Glazyr

- Your agent browses the web through an MCP client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Antigravity, Cursor, Codex) and page-state tokens dominate your cost.
- You need actionable state: link URLs, form field names and labels, select options, and layout coordinates — not screenshots or guessed pixels.

## Install

Linux x64, Node 18+. Add to your MCP client config:

{ "mcpServers": { "glazyr": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@glazyr/mcp"] } } }

Windows: run it inside WSL — set "command": "wsl.exe", "args": ["-d", "Ubuntu", "--", "npx", "-y", "@glazyr/mcp"] (use your own distro name). First run downloads a ~106 MB browser bundle; run `npx -y @glazyr/mcp` once beforehand so the first client connect does not time out. macOS is not yet supported.

## Known limits (published by the project)

- Page state is served with liveness and freshness checks: if the browser process dies, the tools refuse rather than serve stale state.
- No pixel streaming yet — Glazyr serves semantic state, not screenshots.
